repo_notes.content: Turnkey is a detector-development harness for paired jailbreak-safety evaluation, runtime inspection, and artifact auditing. Explain the end-to-end flow from dataset and attack through target, judge, detector policy, metrics, and audit, and distinguish extension APIs from runtime infrastructure.
repo_notes.author: Turnkey maintainers

repo_notes.content: Treat built-in method integrations as examples of runtime capabilities, not as a research result or leaderboard claim. Preserve the documented distinction between a runnable integration, strict scientific reproduction, and production readiness.
repo_notes.author: Turnkey maintainers

repo_notes.content: Document only committed public source and artifacts. Private prompts, unpublished datasets, internal planning, remote-machine data, and development control-plane material are outside this repository and must not be inferred as product behavior.
